summary_en: Tender offer by UZABASE for Global Information common shares and warrants closed 2026-07-01. Total tendered: 2,775,740 shares (93.29% of S/O ex-treasury). Minimum threshold (1,983,600 shares) exceeded; offer succeeded. Settlement begins 2026-07-08; UZABASE becomes parent company and majority shareholder. Prior major shareholders Yuko Ono and Satoru Ono cease to be principal shareholders.
title_en: Notice regarding results of tender offer for shares and warrants of Global Information by UZABASE and changes in parent company, principal shareholder, and major shareholders
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-01, the public tender offer by UZABASE for all shares and warrants of Global Information (ticker 4171) concluded. The tender offer ran from 2026-05-21 to 2026-07-01. A total of 2,775,740 shares (inclusive of warrant exercises) were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 1,983,600 shares. All tendered securities will be acquired by UZABASE. Settlement of the tender offer will begin on 2026-07-08. Upon settlement, UZABASE's voting rights will represent 93.29% of Global Information's total voting rights (27,757 voting units), exceeding 50% and qualifying UZABASE as the company's new parent company and principal shareholder. Prior major shareholders Yuko Ono (筆頭株主) and Satoru Ono, who tendered all their holdings, will cease to be principal shareholders following settlement. UZABASE is a Tokyo-based company established in October 2022, providing business information infrastructure for corporate decision-making; it is controlled by The Shaper Holdings L.P. (94.91% stake). No prior capital, personnel, transactional, or related-party relationships between Global Information and UZABASE are disclosed.
